sobre.titulo:
A little magic
in Cala Rajada
sobre.texto: We opened in January 2025 with a simple idea: a place where everyone feels welcome. Specialty coffee treated with respect, food prepared fresh every day, and hundreds of board games so you can stay as long as you like.
